title: Is Your Happy Hour Losing You Money?

scenes.say: Happy hour fills the room. It might also be emptying the register.

props.line: The deal that can *drain the register*
props.label: BAR WISDOM

scenes.say: Say a glass of house wine is nine dollars. At happy hour it's five. Take out the wine, the labor and the card fee, and you keep about a dollar thirty-five.
At the full nine dollars, you keep about five twenty-three. So it takes almost four happy hour glasses to match one.
So run it only in hours that would sit empty. Pair the deal with food. And compare sales to a normal week.

props.title: Make it pay
steps: Only in hours that sit empty
